summary: The focused claim is established: after the change, pretty formatting supports one-line output for an empty object, but the old harness cannot build to reach it.

claims.necessity_reason: The entry attempts pretty serialization of parsed input. A valid empty object can reach the changed formatter in the source, but the old entry calls a one-argument function with two arguments, preventing the C++ target from building.

before.requirement: Reach one-line pretty serialization of an empty object.
before.reason: Before the change, pretty formatting always appends a newline after the opening brace, including for an empty object.

after.requirement: Reach one-line pretty serialization of a parsed empty object such as {}.
after.reason: For an empty object, the changed formatter skips both pretty newline sites and appends the closing brace. The old harness cannot reach this behavior because its serialization call has too many arguments.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: An opening brace creates the object passed toward serialization.
A closing brace completes an empty object.
The called serialization function is declared with one argument.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The recipe compiles this entry as C++.

claims.comparison_reason: The frozen one-line empty-object behavior is absent before and supported after. The same old harness has a build blocker after the change, so no input can reach it.
